thread:
Maya: Quick heads-up — launching the newsletter tomorrow morning with a 1-question microsurvey in the header. Need final decisions on segmentation, subject lines, and where inbound survey replies should route. TL;DR: tiny survey -> route hot leads to SDR queue, cold to nurture.

Tom: love the microsurvey idea. can we keep it to a single radio button? fewer clicks = higher response. subject line A/B: "What feature matters most to you?" vs "Tell us one thing you want from LLM infra"

Lucas: send windows — target NA morning 9am local, EU afternoon. Should we do a staggered send (3 waves) to avoid spikes? :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Anya: microsurvey implementation — we're embedding a single-question form with a redirect to a landing page. privacy check: the form should not drop cookies beyond necessary. Also confirm we don't store PII in the survey answers.

Nora: routing: propose this logic — if answer == "Need help now" OR user.plan == "enterprise" -> SFDC queue: SD-Immediate. Else if engagement_score > 50 -> SDR-High. Else -> nurture drip. I can push mappings to SFDC after final sign-off.

Maya: perfect. @Nora can you also add an Intercom tag rule so we can trigger an in-app message for high intent?

Nora: yes, will add tag `microsurvey:high-intent` and a workflow to create Lead in SFDC with source = `newsletter-microsurvey`. Also adding UTM params: utm_source=newsletter&utm_campaign=microsurvey_launch

Tom: small experiment idea — for 20% of recipients show a personalized subject that uses company name var: \`Hi {{company}} — quick question about infra\` and compare open/response.

Lucas: batching plan to reduce cost: 3 waves, 9am / 10:30am / 12pm local. If we see >10% bounce in wave1, pause wave2 and fix. DeployBot: can you run the scheduled send monitor?

DeployBot: scheduled send monitor created: job_id=send-monitor-176777. Alerts -> #release-war-room if delivery rate < 95% or error rate > 1%.

Anya: microsurvey copy (final): "One quick q: what's the biggest blocker to shipping LLM features?" Options: A) Latency / B) Cost / C) Model quality / D) Security & compliance. CTA: "Submit — see tailored tips". Keep under 3 lines.

Maya: OK. Action items: 1) Tom finalize subject variants by EOD. 2) Nora add SFDC & Intercom mappings now. 3) Anya drop in final survey embed + privacy notice. 4) Lucas configure 3-wave send and monitor. I'll run a preflight at 7am tomorrow. If anyone has blockers ping me here — otherwise go ahead. :rocket:
